item.title: [Fri, Oct 16] Telluride Horror Show
item.description: 🎫 Sheridan Opera House 📍 Sheridan Opera House • Telluride, CO Telluride Horror Show is a horror-themed event at the Sheridan Opera House. Taking place in mid-October, the event aligns with the Halloween season and is hosted at one of Telluride's most storied performance venues.

item.title: [Sat, Oct 17] Nattali Rize
item.description: 🎫 The Alibi 📍 The Alibi • Telluride, CO 🕒 9:00 PM Nattali Rize is a conscious artist, lyricist, and musician known for her ever-evolving sound and message-driven music. She performs live at The Alibi in Telluride.

item.title: [Sun, Oct 18] Mountainfilm on Tour – Montrose
item.description: 📍 The Sherbino, Ridgway Mountainfilm on Tour brings a curated selection of short films from the acclaimed Telluride-based Mountainfilm festival to The Sherbino in Ridgway. The traveling program features the documentary and adventure storytelling the festival is known for, presented in a seated screening format with a limited bar available.

item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Historic & Architectural Review Commission - Oct 21 2026 — 2026-10-21
item.description:
Town of Telluride • 2026-10-21
The October 21 HARC meeting is anchored by the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment Project — the Town of Telluride's own large-scale development at 860 Black Bear Rd, zoned Accommodations 2. HARC takes up Buildings 1 and 2 as one public hearing item and Buildings 3 and 4 as a second, both continued from August 19. Each application covers new construction outside the Telluride Historic Landmark District exceeding 5,000 square feet of floor area under LUC 7-203.B.2.a.1. Also on the agenda: a payment-in-lieu of parking request for one space at 510 W Columbia Ave/129 N Townsend in the Historic Residential zone, where HARC is asked to support administrative approval. A small-scale new construction application at 785 Primrose Lane on a steep site is also up for review. The 448 Tomboy Road item has been continued to December 16 at the applicant's request, and the 214 S Fir Certificate of Appropriateness Amendment #2 — in the works since at least December 2025 — is being tabled for eight more months.
⚡ Why it matters: Public hearings on all four buildings of the Town's Shandoka Lot redevelopment.

item.title: [Thu, Oct 22] Rocky Horror Picture Show Live Shadow Cast Edition
item.description: 📍 The Sherbino, Ridgway The Rocky Horror Picture Show Live Shadow Cast at the Sherbino – October 22–25, 2026 @ TICKETS The Rocky Horror Picture Show — Shadow Cast Edition Thursday, Friday, & Saturday Performances: Doors: 7:30pm || Show: 8:00pm (Oct. 22-24) Sunday Matinee: Doors: 2:30pm || Show: 3:00pm (Oct. 25)Directed by Erin Cawley Ages 18+ (under 18 with parental permission or parent is accompanying minor) Tickets: $15 + $15 required prop/supply fee Don’t dream it… be it. Get ready to do the Time Warp again as The Rocky Horror Picture Show returns to the Sherbino in full shadow-cast style! Part movie screening, part live theater, and completely outrageous, this cult-classic experience features a live local cast performing along with the film on stage—lip-syncing, dancing, and bringing your favorite characters and scenes to life right in front of the screen. And at Rocky Horror, the audience isn’t just watching. …
